request: Analyze GSE298607 for PMID 40581981 (Long non-coding RNAs Kcnq1ot1 and Lncpint are involved in skeletal muscle atrophy induced by the space exposome.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, paired-end NovaSeq X Plus), mouse soleus; featureCounts on GRCm39/GENCODE M33 (S2.6.p2)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of a combined spaceflight analogue (14-day hindlimb unloading + 1 Gy whole-body X-ray on day 7 + oral corticosterone 5 mg/kg/day) versus pair-fed, sham-irradiated controls on soleus gene expression (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.5.p1, S3.1.p1). This is a disuse/atrophy model; there is no exercise or training arm anywhere in the mouse experiment.
final.sample_inclusion: 20 male C57BL/6J mice, 10 CONTROL and 10 SPACE, one soleus each (S2.3.p1, FIG1)
planned_contrasts: SPACE vs CONTROL, protein-coding genes (S3.1.p1; paper: 6191 DEGs, 2666 up / 3525 down, FDR < 0.01)
SPACE vs CONTROL, lncRNAs (S3.2.p1; paper: 465 DE lncRNAs, 340 up / 125 down, 'P < 0.01' / -log10FDR > 2)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; independent animals (pair-fed controls matched to SPACE mice for food intake, S2.3.p3, but pairing not recorded in GEO)
final.paper_results: Mstn +1.6, Myh4 +5.1, Myh1 +2.1, Myh7 -1.7, Myh3 -2.1, Ppara -1.9, H19 -2.0, Kcnq1ot1 +0.31, Lncpint +0.86 logFC (S3.1.p2-p5, ABS.p1)
final.exercise_content: Exercise is mentioned only in the Introduction as a known countermeasure in human bed rest literature (S1.p4); not part of any experiment in this paper.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.3-S2.6 define a two-arm mouse experiment (CONTROL vs SPACE). The human bed-rest data (microarray, re-analysed, not in GSE298607) and the 3-D myostatin cell model are qPCR/other datasets. No exercise, training or loading intervention is applied to any group. The Introduction's mention of resistance exercise (S1.p4) is background only.

checks: GEO: soleus muscle, C57BL/6J, Mus musculus, 20 samples = 10 control + 10 space, matching S2.3.p1/FIG1 n=10+10
GEO characteristics list hindlimb unloading, ionizing radiation and stress hormone, matching S2.3-S2.5
data_processing: subread + featureCounts v1.5.1, GENCODE M33, edgeR TMM, matching S2.6.p2-p3

ownership.reasoning: Accession, tissue, strain, sample number, arms and processing all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns S1001-S1020 sit inside the GEO description field ('Library name: Sample 1,S1001'); inspect reports 20/20 matches. Group comes from the title suffix (control/space), consistent with characteristics_ch1.2.treatment (sham-irradiation vs Hind-limb unloading). Titles repeat 'Sample 1..10' in each arm, so the title number is not used as a key.

final.paper_input: featureCounts gene counts analysed with edgeR (S2.6.p2-p3)

matrix.reasoning: 100% integer values, max 8.6M, median 0, 56,941 Ensembl gene IDs; file name 'raw_counts' and GEO data_processing state featureCounts gene counts summarised before TMM/log2CPM. Consistent with the paper's edgeR input.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the only comparison in GSE298607 is a spaceflight analogue (hindlimb unloading + irradiation + corticosterone) versus sham control. There is no exercise, training or loading arm; unloading is a disuse intervention, and its effect cannot be relabelled as (or inverted into) an exercise effect. The request's estimand (exercise effect on gene expression) is not identifiable from these data.

candidates.value: grp SPACE vs CONTROL as an 'exercise' contrast
candidates.reason_rejected: SPACE is unloading+radiation+stress (disuse/atrophy), not exercise; the control is not an exercise group either (pair-fed, caged, sham-irradiated). Reporting it as an exercise effect would change the estimand.

candidates.value: CONTROL vs SPACE reversed as 'loading/activity vs disuse'
candidates.reason_rejected: Inverting a disuse model does not estimate an exercise effect; the arm also carries irradiation and corticosterone, which are aliased with unloading.

design.reasoning: Paper S2.3.p1 defines two arms, CONTROL and SPACE; GEO confirms 10+10 with the same labels. Exercise appears only as background in S1.p4. The paper's own SPACE vs CONTROL contrast is analyzable in principle (n=10/arm, raw counts, edgeR), but it answers a different question (space exposome / disuse atrophy), so the requested exercise analysis is refused here.

discrepancies.paper: S3.2.p1 and ABS.p1 say 'P < 0.01'; FIG2 legend says '-log10FDR > 2'
